comments.body:
I think this breaks any per-icon fill/stroke override (only currentColor-based works).

`Icons::SpriteIcon.new(name: "academic-cap", library: "heroicons", variant: :outline, arguments: { fill: "red" }).svg` and `Icons::SpriteIcon.new(name: "academic-cap", library: "heroicons", variant: :outline, arguments: { stroke: "blue" }).svg` both are not passed along. 

Could you check?

Thanks @eelcoj, good catch: attributes on the `<symbol>` take precedence over inherited ones, so the override never got through. I moved the root `fill`/`stroke`/`stroke-linecap`/`stroke-linejoin` from the symbol to the referencing `<svg>` as defaults (in `SpriteIcon`), so `arguments: { fill: "red" }` and `{ stroke: "blue" }` now win. Added tests for both; pushed as a new commit. One trade-off: `SpriteIcon` now reads the icon file at render time to get those defaults (like inline icons already do); happy to memoize it if you prefer.

This comment was drafted with Claude Code.
